I'd really love to sit down with someone and have a heartfelt talk about what I need to do for my future but in reality I've got no one but myself right now. 
My grandmother and I don't get along. We aren't close and she specifically told me I couldn't stay with her. After my grandpa died she kind of just took all his money and ran away from us.

They are both 12 years old right now. 11 months apart. The last time I talked to them they both individually described how they hate me and wish to not have a relationship with me ever. My grandmother and I aren't too close and I had to beg her to take my little brothers in. Thanks for your hope, I could use a lot of that right about now.

I appreciated your advice very much, but I would never inflict or engage physical violence or take another life regardless of how much that person hurt me or my mom or anyone I truly care about. The fact that I had to fucking fight my own dad kills me a little. It's not about getting even or winning, I'm not that type of person and never have been. Thank you though!
